title: AFFORD2ACT: How Far Can Sparse Keypoints Go for Robot Manipulation?
abstract: arXiv:2510.01433v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-based manipulation policies are commonly learned from rich visual observations, typically using dense visual features extracted from full resolution images. It remains unclear how much of this visual information is really needed for effective policy learning. In this paper, we investigate the opposite end of the spectrum: how effective can manipulation policies be if they use as input only a compact visual representation. Sparse 2D keypoints provide a deliberately compact representation, giving the policy spatial information while removing direct access to appearance, texture, and background. We design AFFORD2ACT (Affordance-Guided Keypoints to Act) to study how much manipulation capability can be retained under this representation constraint. An off-the-shelf language-conditioned affordance model identifies the task-relevant region, from which up to 15 object keypoints are selected, together with 4 end-effector keypoint

translated_title: AFFORD2ACT：稀疏关键点在机器人操作中能走多远？
translated_abstract: 基于视觉的操作策略通常从丰富的视觉观测中学习，典型做法是使用从全分辨率图像中提取的密集视觉特征。然而，目前尚不清楚这些视觉信息中究竟有多少是有效策略学习真正需要的。在本文中，我们研究了光谱的另一端：如果操作策略仅使用紧凑的视觉表示作为输入，它们能达到怎样的效果？稀疏2D关键点提供了一种刻意紧凑的表示，在为策略提供空间信息的同时，移除了对外观、纹理和背景的直接访问。我们设计了AFFORD2ACT（Affordance-Guided Keypoints to Act，可供性引导的关键点到动作）来研究在这种表示约束下能够保留多少操作能力。一个现成的语言条件可供性模型用于识别与任务相关的区域，从中最多选取15个物体关键点，连同4个末端执行器关键点一起作为策略输入。
tldr: 本文提出AFFORD2ACT方法，证明借助语言条件可供性模型选取任务相关区域的少量稀疏2D关键点（最多15个物体关键点加4个末端执行器关键点）作为紧凑视觉表示，即可实现有效的机器人操作策略学习。
en_tdlr: AFFORD2ACT demonstrates that robot manipulation policies can remain effective using only a deliberately compact representation of sparse 2D keypoints (up to 15 object keypoints plus 4 end-effector keypoints) selected from task-relevant regions identified by a language-conditioned affordance model.
